Override.entitydescription.aw_boot1:
If you don't like heels

"Bottoms" overrides the surface of either the entire leg completely, or partially the shin and the entire foot.


A clothing set to increase variety and compatibility with other mods, for example, to prevent the character from levitating.
Item compatibility is extremely limited, especially for footwear.

Can be crafted by "μ ‖color:gui.yellow‖Crafting kit‖end‖" and equipped into belt slot.
Override.entitydescription.aw_boot2:
"Bottoms" overrides the surface of either the entire leg completely, or the shin and foot.

A clothing set to increase variety and compatibility with other mods, for example, to prevent the character from levitating.
Equips in the "gene splicer" slot, and dont provide any bonuses.
To quickly equip or swap an item for another, simply press its number on the slot-bar.
If you need to remove an item, you can do so through the H (health) menu.
If dropped on the ground, the item will disappear after 30 seconds.

High compatibility when combined with clothing that doesn't have huge jackets or cloaks, as well as dresses.


A clothing set to increase variety and compatibility with other mods, for example, to prevent the character from levitating.
Item compatibility is extremely limited, especially for footwear.

Can be crafted by "μ ‖color:gui.yellow‖Crafting kit‖end‖" and equipped into belt slot.
